'''Nation:''' Ascalon
'''Profession:''' Elementalist
'''Age:''' 20
A former child prodigy, Cynn always had people catering to her every whim. Her family was among the nobility in the city of [[Surmia]]—until the [[Charr invasion]] and [[the Searing]]. When [[Ascalon]] was destroyed, Cynn got caught outside [[Great Northern Wall|the Wall]] (Surmia was one of the first places to fall during the initial assault). A magical projectile fell directly upon her palatial home, killing her parents and trapping her under a broken table for several days. A [[Charr]] [[warband]] discovered her while looting the city. They dug her out, thinking to make a meal of her, but Cynn had other ideas. She single-handedly wiped out the entire warband, turning them and the remains of her home into little more than a smoldering pile of ash. Cynn is a bit of a princess but with a decidedly dark streak. She's often cynical and flippant when dealing with authorities or situations that seem hopeless. She's highly intelligent, and magic comes easy to her. Because of her experiences during the Searing, Cynn has developed a rather cavalier attitude toward her own death. Consequently, she tends to bite off more than she can chew, and often gets herself and her friends into trouble.}} {{quotation|factions|Cynn is a bit of a princess but with a decidedly dark streak. She’s often cynical and flippant when dealing with authorities or situations that seem hopeless. She’s highly intelligent, and magic comes easily to her. Because of her experiences during the Searing, Cynn has developed a rather cavalier attitude toward her own death. Consequently, she tends to bite off more than she can chew, and often gets herself and her friends into trouble. She has joined Mhenlo’s expedition to Cantha to satisfy her own curiosity, to learn new ways to make things explode, and out of an honest (though well-hidden) desire to stop the mysterious threat in Cantha before the southern continent sees the same kind of devastation that has wracked the northern realms of Tyria.}} [[Cynn]] (born either 1051 or 1052 [[Mouvelian calendar|AE]]) is a former noble of Ascalon. After the Searing destroyed her hometown, she joined up with [[Mhenlo]], [[Devona]], [[Aidan]], and later [[Eve]]. She and Mhenlo have been in a relationship since their time in Ascalon. Along with the others, she joined [[Prince Rurik]] in an assault against the Charr and eventually joined the [[Ascalonian migration]] to [[Kryta]]. Afterward, the group traveled across [[Tyria]], participating in the fulfillment of the [[Flameseeker Prophecies]]. Afterward, she joined Mhenlo's expedition to [[Cantha]] in aiding with the [[Afflicted]] in order to satisfy her own curiosity and to learn new ways to explode things. Though she kept it well hidden, she had an honest desire to stop the threat in Cantha before it saw a similar kind of devastation that occurred to Tyria. During the group's time in Cantha, she was often infuriated over Mhenlo's old friends from when he was a student at [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. In 1075 AE, she and the others were recruited by [[Kormir]] to join the [[Order of the Sunspears]] against [[Varesh Ossa]], [[Abaddon]], and their [[demon]]ic [[Margonite]]s during [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]]. During 1078 AE, the group aided in the fight against the [[Destroyer]]s and [[the Great Destroyer|their master]]. When she met the [[Asura]]n people, she showed an uncharacteristic kindness to them. What she and the group did after is unknown, but the group appears a year later for [[Gwen]] and [[Keiran Thackeray]]'s [[The Wedding|wedding]], during which Cynn is upset at Mhenlo since she is still unmarried. (The others are [[Aidan]], Devona, Eve, and Mhenlo.) *She is labeled as a "[[Mage Henchman]]" in ''Prophecies'' and ''Factions'', and as a "[[Fire Henchman]]" in ''Nightfall'' and ''Eye of the North''. ==Trivia== *Her henchmen skill sets were changed in the [[Game updates/20091022|October 22, 2009 update]]. As an ally in Raisu Palace, she uses the Factions skill set prior to that update. **Prophecies: This added [[Elemental Attunement]] (elite), [[Rodgort's Invocation]], [[Immolate]], and [[Aura of Restoration]], and removed [[Fire Storm]], [[Incendiary Bonds]], and [[Mind Burn]] (elite) from her skills. ***The update misspelled the added Immolate as "Immolation". **Factions: This added [[Elemental Attunement]] (elite), [[Immolate]], [[Lava Arrows]], and [[Teinai's Heat]], and removed [[Fire Storm]], [[Incendiary Bonds]], and [[Mind Burn]] (elite) from her skills. **Nightfall: This added [[Searing Flames]] (elite), [[Glowing Gaze]], and [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]], and removed [[Fire Storm]], [[Incendiary Bonds]], and [[Mind Burn]] (elite) from her skills. **Eye of the North: This added [["Never Surrender!"]] to her skills. ***Though it wasn't mentioned it seems that this also removed [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]] from her Eye of the North skill set. *In pre-Searing Ascalon she is seen holding a [[Mesmer]] [[Cane]]. *Despite being a fire [[Elementalist]], she carries an [[Earth Staff]] when she is a henchman. *Cynn is depicted multiple times: **On the ''Guild Wars Prophecies'' cover. **On the [[Elementalist]] tab in the [[:File:Choose primary profession Factions.jpg|character creation screen]]. *The quote "The next person to call me 'hot lips' gets scorched." is a very likely reference to the television show [[w:M*A*S*H|M*A*S*H]]. *Her name derives from the Old English word for fire "fýrcynn". *Clipping through her character model reveals that she is wearing thong underwear. {{henchmen nav|Prophecies|Factions|Nightfall|Eye of the North}} [[Category:Prophecies quest givers]] [[Category:Elementalist henchmen]] [[Category:Mhenlo's Crew]]
